lines.11: 「It's true that I loved you, Princess, and part of me still admires you.」
lines.12: 「But as the girl I want to be with, I choose Yoshimi.」
lines.13: 「Yoshimi told me she loved someone like me.」
lines.14: 「You have no idea how happy that made me...」
lines.16: The Princess looked as though she couldn't believe it.
lines.18: 「When you accepted Yoppi's confession, wasn't it because... you were settling for her?」
lines.20: 「But now I like her more every day.」
lines.23: 「I already loved you, Leo, and I love you more every day, too.」
lines.24: 「So I don't care what you were feeling when you first said yes.」
lines.30: 「Please don't be mad at the Princess.」
lines.34: 「Ellie always thought she could have anything her way, so I think this taught her a useful lesson.」
lines.37: 「Ahahahaha! Sorry, I couldn't hold that in.」
lines.39: 「Well, I did hate to give up such a fun toy...」
lines.40: 「but I never realized you two were that madly in love.」
lines.43: 「Of course. In the end, it was still only an extension of a game.」
lines.44: 「Though I suppose I made Yoppi angry. Sorry.」
lines.45: 「Ahaha, it's fine. Don't worry about it.」
lines.46: 「Come on, Leo. Let's go home together.」
lines.48: 「My, my. Showing off already, are we?」
lines.51: The Princess never let her cheerful smile slip.
lines.52: She was perfectly fine even though I hadn't chosen her.
lines.53: Maybe that meant I had never mattered much to her at all.
lines.56: Yoshimi practically pushed me out of the student council room.
lines.57: The setting sun stung my eyes.
lines.58: 「Here's to us staying friends from tomorrow on, Ellie!」
lines.59: 「Yeah... Sorry, Yoppi. I pulled a strange stunt.」
lines.62: 「It would be cruel of me to stay angry when you're the one left with nothing.」
lines.70: 「The Princess really is tough. Or maybe just unfazed.」
lines.71: 「I know it's selfish to ask, Yoshimi, but please don't be angry with her.」
lines.73: 「Ellie and I will be just like before, so don't worry about that.」
lines.75: 「I wonder if the Princess and I can go back to how we were, too.」
lines.76: 「Of course. She has her pride to protect.」
lines.82: 「You're such an idiot, Leo. Not choosing me...」
lines.88: 「I'll use even this pain as a springboard and claw my way higher...」
lines.89: 「This is the last time I'll ever cry...」
lines.90: 「First, I need to regain my composure... become my usual self again.」
lines.91: 「Tomorrow, I won't let my smile slip...」
lines.92: 「Don't sulk here and waste time... Use these feelings instead...」
lines.105: All right. Time to give today my best, too.
lines.106: In the end, there were no lingering grudges.
lines.108: The Princess and Yoshimi were still best friends.
lines.109: The Princess and I were classmates.
lines.119: 「I want to know how you really feel, Ellie.」
lines.121: 「Don't you want to steal Leo back?」
lines.123: 「Normally I wouldn't, but you're the one I'm up against, Yoppi.」
lines.125: 「Once I drew that line, I felt much better.」
lines.127: 「I thought you'd take him back just out of stubborn pride.」
lines.129: 「You were blasting me with that 'you know what'll happen if you touch him' aura.」
lines.131: 「If I went after him, you and I really would have a huge fight, wouldn't we?」
lines.132: 「I don't want that, so I gave up. We made a promise, too.」
lines.134: 「And I can do without having coffee thrown on me again.」
lines.135: 「Ahaha. If it happened again, it wouldn't be coffee.」
lines.136: 「...Y-Yes. Retreating was definitely the right choice.」
lines.137: 「Still, I know I'm repeating myself, but I'm amazed you're actually willing to step aside.」
lines.138: 「I told you, it's because I'm up against you, Yoppi.」
lines.142: 「You can't always get what you want. Sometimes you only realize how precious something was after it's gone.」
lines.143: 「A tremendous gain. I'll use it to grow even stronger.」
lines.144: 「Ellie, you're positive to the bitter end...」
lines.146: 「Make sure you don't let Leo get away, either. This time I'll support you wholeheartedly.」
lines.148: 「About 'that'--I mean your distrust of people--Leo chose you over me back there. You can trust him.」
lines.150: 「What's wrong? You look ready to cry.」
lines.151: 「I'm just so glad things are back to normal between us.」
lines.153: 「I said some cruel things to you at the end.」
lines.154: 「My own behavior was questionable, so let's call it even.」
lines.160: Student council work had been rough today.
lines.162: The Princess had rushed off, saying she had something to do.
lines.163: People left one by one, until only Yoshimi and I remained.
lines.166: 「Oh, right... I'll lock up in a minute, so... l-let's walk home together.」
lines.168: I was honestly happy to get an invitation like that.
lines.170: Yoshimi started tidying everything with practiced efficiency.
lines.172: I could at least wash the teacups.
lines.173: 「Oh, that's all right. I'll wash them.」
lines.175: But I was already holding a teacup,
lines.178: We froze and stared at each other.
lines.181: We both jerked our hands away.
lines.183: Neither of us had much to say after that.
lines.184: Our pounding hearts filled the silence instead.
lines.187: Yoshimi nodded, her face bright red.
lines.189: We left the student council room.
